meta.title: Our Fleet | 1-800-Limo
meta.description: Explore our premium fleet collection including Sedans, SUVs, Limousines, and Vans for all your transportation needs.
meta.keywords: fleet, luxury cars, vehicles, rentals, limousine, sedan, SUV, van, party bus

vehicles.name: Sedan - Midsize
vehicles.description: These vehicles are ideal for affordable rides for 1-2 passengers between any two points. Choose a standard sedan or upgrade to luxury models like BMW or Infiniti for added comfort.

vehicles.name: Sedan – Full-Size
vehicles.description: Perfect for 3-4 passengers or travelers needing extra legroom and trunk space. Available in premium options such as Mercedes or Lexus for a refined experience.

vehicles.name: Handicap – Vans & Buses
vehicles.description: Designed to support passengers with mobility needs. We match you with the right driver and vehicle to ensure a safe and comfortable ride.

vehicles.name: Crossover & SUVs
vehicles.badge: Extra room for passengers and luggage
vehicles.description: Upgrade your ride with more cabin space and storage. Ideal for families, small groups, or shared rides.

vehicles.name: Armored / Security Vehicles
vehicles.description: Armored sedans, SUVs, vans, and minibuses available with or without security personnel, depending on your needs and location.

vehicles.name: Minivan / Sprinter / Passenger Van
vehicles.description: Ideal for larger groups needing extra seating and luggage space.

vehicles.name: Stretch Limo
vehicles.description: A classic choice for weddings, proms, and special events. Spacious interiors designed for comfort and celebration.

vehicles.name: Mini-Bus
vehicles.description: Best suited for short trips such as events, meetings, or shuttles between venues. Comfortable seating for medium-sized groups.

vehicles.name: Limo / Party Bus
vehicles.description: Designed for celebrations and group transfers. Perfect for parties, weddings, and nightlife events with premium entertainment.

vehicles.name: SUV - Standard
vehicles.description: A reliable and versatile SUV option for small groups. Great for airport transfers, city tours, and day trips with ample luggage space.

vehicles.name: Sedan – Executive
vehicles.description: Top-tier sedans for business executives. Featuring Mercedes S-Class, BMW 7-Series, and Audi A8 for the ultimate in comfort and style.

vehicles.name: Luxury Sprinter
vehicles.description: Premium Sprinter vans with luxury interiors, perfect for corporate groups, wedding parties, and VIP transfers.

vehicles.name: SUV – Stretch
vehicles.description: Stretch SUV limousines combining the elegance of a limo with the ruggedness of an SUV. Perfect for proms, bachelor parties, and special occasions.

vehicles.name: Motor Coach
vehicles.description: Full-size motor coaches for large group transportation. Ideal for corporate events, conventions, charter tours, and long-distance group travel.

vehicles.name: Classic / Vintage Car
vehicles.description: Classic and vintage vehicles for weddings, photo shoots, and special occasions. Make a grand entrance with a timeless ride.
